findings.title: No hardcoded secrets or API keys in source
findings.recommendation: Move the Stripe secret key to an environment variable (e.g. STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) and read it via process.env; rotate the exposed key.

findings.title: Webhook signature verification on every webhook handler
findings.recommendation: Call stripe.webhooks.constructEvent with the raw request body and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET before parsing the event.

findings.title: RLS (or equivalent rules) enabled on every table holding user data
findings.recommendation: Remove the `disable row level security` statement and add row level security policies scoping documents to their owner.

findings.title: CORS not wildcard; credentials handling correct
findings.recommendation: Replace the wildcard CORS header with an explicit allow-list of trusted origins.

findings.title: Custom 404 page returning a real 404 status
findings.recommendation: Add app/not-found.tsx with a custom 404 page so unmatched routes return a real 404 status.

findings.title: Privacy policy exists and matches actual data practices
findings.recommendation: Add a privacy policy page describing what data is collected and how it is used, matching the app's actual data practices.
